SELECT m.id, m.member_no, m.real_name, m.gender, m.phone, m.birthday, m.level_id, ml.level_name, m.total_points, m.available_points, m.total_recharge, m.balance, m.total_consumption, m.last_login_time, m.last_online_time, m.total_online_hours, m.register_source, m.status, m.blacklist_reason, m.tag, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM member m LEFT JOIN member_level ml ON m.level_id = ml.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL
AND m.member_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{memberNo}, '%')
AND m.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND m.status = #{status}
AND m.level_id = #{levelId}
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM member WHERE phone = #{phone} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM member WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT m.id, m.member_no, m.real_name, m.gender, m.phone, m.birthday, m.level_id, ml.level_name, m.total_points, m.available_points, m.total_recharge, m.balance, m.total_consumption, m.last_login_time, m.last_online_time, m.total_online_hours, m.register_source, m.status, m.blacklist_reason, m.tag, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM member m LEFT JOIN member_level ml ON m.level_id = ml.id WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
